scope.experiment: Exploratory backend system adaptation conditional on frozen front-end and accepted retrieval outputs.
scope.disclosure: All three TUM sequences and earlier results were inspected before designing these adaptations. Validation is exploratory external-sequence validation, not unseen test data.
scope.selection: Final Sim(3)-aligned trajectory ATE RMSE on desk only; one main policy frozen before desk2/room validation. Validation does not reselect parameters.
not_tested_by_replay: different retrieval or loop acceptance thresholds
scope.default_change_rule: At least 2% lower ATE on each of desk2 and room versus freshly reproduced matching legacy; otherwise remain opt-in.
scope.metric_note: These are whole-SLAM trajectory ATE results from the replay/evo-style Sim(3) evaluator. They do not reuse archived local bf16 rotation-angle metrics.

original_adaptation_plan.purpose: Exploratory system adaptation; previously viewed TUM data are not an unseen benchmark
original_adaptation_plan.selection: Freeze one backend candidate using desk ATE only; report desk2 and room separately and pooled geometric mean ratio, no retuning on validation. Change one mechanism at a time before combined candidate.
original_adaptation_plan.frontend_selection: Compare on desk; pick at most one new density/size configuration for both validation sequences. Fixed same-frame context probe is a diagnostic, not a score-selection pool.
original_adaptation_plan.success_rule: A default change needs at least 2% lower ATE on each of desk2 and room vs freshly reproduced matching legacy; otherwise expose opt-in and preserve legacy default.
original_adaptation_plan.gpu: one cooperating GPU job at a time, shared existing lock, >=2048 MiB reserve, foreign compute PID check before forwards
original_adaptation_plan.replay: Cache complete predictions including accepted loops. Verify legacy CPU replay against online poses before selecting backend candidates. Replay measures backend effects conditional on fixed front-end/retrieval outputs.

amendments.stage: before backend candidate selection and validation
amendments.change: Specify minimum practical improvement of 2% on each validation sequence, stricter than any numeric decrease.

interpretation.confidence_results: All five new confidence/scale-selection variants are worse than legacy on desk whole-SLAM ATE. The earlier overlap-scale-only q75 candidate is not a whole-SLAM improvement.
interpretation.selection_correction: The initial combined exploration selected among new masks only. The main development explicitly includes legacy, which wins the mask stage; all original results and the superseded freeze are retained below.
interpretation.main_mechanism: The selected noise_only policy calls the original add_edge and preserves upstream scale/mask/fallback behavior. It multiplies ordinary cross-submap Gaussian standard deviations by 2 and leaves loop noise at 1; no Huber is selected.
interpretation.noise_semantics: Multipliers scale standard deviations. A multiplier of 2 gives one quarter of the Gaussian information weight for the affected factors.
interpretation.confidence_semantics: Mask percentiles are separate from cloud filtering. Frame candidates compute each participating overlap frame percentile independently; own_stored_q25 reuses each submap own stored cloud q25 cutoff. These are implemented confidence/scale-selection variants, including their documented validity/fallback handling.
limitations: One development sequence and two previously inspected validation sequences provide exploratory evidence only.
Accepted loops are frozen; replay cannot evaluate rejected loops or alternative attention thresholds.
A small desk ATE decrease does not establish a robust accuracy gain or the cause of the focal-length bias.

design.correction: The mask selection pool includes legacy; every new mask lost to legacy. Preserve legacy scale selection and tune noise_only.
design.selection_metric: desk final Sim3 ATE RMSE only
design.tie_rule: unchanged legacy, then fewer modified sigma values, then smaller sigma multipliers; Gaussian over equal Huber

frozen_main_selection.criterion: desk final Sim3 ATE RMSE only
frozen_main_selection.supersedes_for_selection: frozen_selection.json (retained combined exploration with a worse mask)
frozen_main_selection.scope: backend noise only; predictions, accepted loops and upstream scale/masks/fallbacks frozen

superseded_combined_exploration.status: Retained evidence; superseded for main policy selection and validation.
superseded_combined_exploration.reason: The initial mask selection omitted legacy even though every new mask lost. The corrected main stage uses legacy mask selection and noise_only.

design.selection_metric: desk final Sim3 ATE RMSE only
design.stages: select mask, then 3x3 sigma grid on that mask, then Huber on best Gaussian only
design.tie_rule: stored cutoff, then frame q closest to 25 (lower q on ties); fewer sigma changes then smaller multipliers; Gaussian over equal Huber

frozen_selection.criterion: desk final Sim3 ATE RMSE only
frozen_selection.scope: backend conditional on these frozen camera/depth/confidence predictions and accepted loops

baseline.duplicates_policy: first occurrence in input file, then sort by timestamp

candidate.duplicates_policy: first occurrence in input file, then sort by timestamp

groundtruth.duplicates_policy: first occurrence in input file, then sort by timestamp

common_trajectory_support.limitation: Piecewise linear interpolation between sparse keyframes is supplementary; it cannot establish the actual motion between those frames. No extrapolation is used.
common_trajectory_support.selection: supplementary validation only; original development ATE selection remains frozen

common_groundtruth_support.query_source: unique ground-truth timestamps in common interval
common_groundtruth_support.alignment: independent Sim(3) Umeyama alignment to identical ground-truth positions

exact_shared_prediction_support.alignment: independent Sim(3) Umeyama alignment to identical ground-truth positions
exact_shared_prediction_support.query_source: exact shared prediction timestamps within ground-truth range; ground truth linearly interpolated

desk2.common_support_role: Supplementary validation only; piecewise-linear interpolation is not a measured dense trajectory and does not change the original ATE selection.

independent_audit.legacy_gate_hash_field_note: The legacy_gate_sha256 field in frozen_main_selection.json hashes the combined noise_only_identity_gate.json (legacy and identity checks), not legacy_equivalence_gate.json. Both contained gate payloads equal the single legacy gate. All four main frozen hash checks match.

provenance.hash_convention: SHA256 values identify the original local source artifact bytes before path redaction; embedded objects preserve original fields and numeric values. Absolute project paths were made relative and external TUM paths use <TUM_ROOT>.
provenance.artifact_note: No source RGB images, NPZ prediction tensors, checkpoints or private sequences are included. Relative paths identify local experiment artifacts, many ignored by Git; they are provenance labels, not a promise that the artifacts are shipped.
